scoring_justification: Fixed deterministic computed quantities from DFT: the raw band-structure and total-energy data are not part of the scored artifact, so recompute from raw (T1) is infeasible. Result-level comparison with tolerances is appropriate.

hidden_assets.purpose: hidden gold values for all seven computed properties
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 3 (rumpling), Table 4 (surface energies), Fig. 2 text and discussion (bandgaps)
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted directly from the published manuscript
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the original paper-reported DFT results for bulk CaHfO3 and its CaO/HfO2 terminations; they form the authoritative reference for this reproduction task.

outputs.description: Aggregated file containing the seven computed DFT quantities. The hidden checker reads this file and compares each numeric field to the paper‑reported gold using absolute tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The task uses Quantum ESPRESSO, an open‑source DFT code. The solver must choose appropriate PAW pseudopotentials for Ca, Hf, O (GGA‑PBE). All intermediate DFT artefacts (optimised bulk geometry, slab coordinates, band‑structure data, total energies) are needed by the process steps and must be produced by the agent; they are not provided as pre‑computed resources.
